correctness.rationale: The Walsh eigenvalues \(2j(n-j)\) on the even-parity cube give the exact dipole integral. Its positivity and strict radial monotonicity determine all current signs, and counting the three edge classes reduces the total absolute current to two even-binomial moments \(S=1/[2(n-1)]\) and \(U=1/4\). The resulting cut and trace-derived cycle formulas were separately checked by exact rational finite computations for dimensions 3 through 11, including direct grounded Laplacian solutions in dimensions 3 through 6. The unrestricted proof is analytical, not a finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The natural distance-regular graph family has \(2^{n-1}\) vertices and quadratic degree \(n(n-1)/2\). An unrestricted exact endpoint operator norm classification, with a positive integral explanation of signs and sharp asymptotic slope \(1/4\), is informative independently of computation. It is not an arbitrary slice or a resistance-trace recomputation: the \(\ell_1\) norm includes every off-diagonal absolute current.
